category_name: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice
title: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice - Hisn al-Muslim 246
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
transliteration: Bismillāh wallāhu Akbar [Allāhumma minka wa lak] Allāhumma taqabbal minnī
translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.
